location.description: Nominal/static location of the Thing. For mobile platforms, this is the deployment position (e.g. mooring point); time-varying position is recorded via position observations.

properties.description: Open metadata object (manufacturer, model, serial number, deployment date, etc.)

main.description: A physical object (station, platform, device) capable of hosting sensors.

altMm.description: Altitude in mm above WGS84 ellipsoid

geoPoint.description: WGS84 point. Coordinates as integers: latE7 = lat × 1e7, lonE7 = lon × 1e7. Altitude in millimetres. To be replaced with ATGeo community type when available.
